attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `thiK`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls, and the model names it in 99.8% of calls with 0.02 bits. Then columns 1 to 79 open as fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 70% of calls.

**A parallel path runs through the first columns.** Columns 1 to 14 carry a second branch of 14 persistent families, `nagZ` to `cobB`, at 10% of chromosomes, each following the previous one. The most carried families there are forks: `lpoB` to `fabD`, at 84 to 90%. The model reads this stretch easily, naming 70 to 100% of genes.

**The middle is a long variable run.** Columns 24 to 71, `flgJ` to `ghrA`, sit at 83 to 89% of chromosomes, all persistent: [[flagellar assembly]] genes, then `mdoH`, `mdoG` and `mdoC` for [[glucan biosynthesis]], and the `csg` genes for [[curli production]]. The model names 95% of genes on average across the window, with 0.27 bits.

**Hesitation peaks near the end.** Column 72, `ycdU`, is the most hesitant at 1.66 bits and the fewest named at 70%, in a region of plasticity in 58% of calls; columns 73 and 74 follow at 1.22 and 0.95 bits. Columns 76 to 79 carry a second branch of 4 persistent families, `efeU` to `putA`, at 13 to 23%. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.35 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 98%.

label: thiK
facts:
WINDOW: the thiK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor thiK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,588 to 2,667 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying thiK once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.27 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,006 calls, named 99%, 0.13 bits; shell 4,854 calls, named 69%, 1.23 bits; cloud 180 calls, named 6%, 4.03 bits. Outside an RGP 38,679 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 4,361 calls, named 71%, 1.35 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 27 fork, 52 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.35 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 98%); 4,361 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 72 (ycdU) 1.66 bits, RGP 58%; column 73 ("IS3 family transposase") 1.22 bits, RGP 66%; column 74 (dgcT) 0.95 bits, RGP 70%. The 7 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.92 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 96%, 0.21 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-70%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: thiK. named 99.8%; 0.02 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-70%. named 70-100% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 72, named 70%, 1.66 bits.
   a second branch of 14 families through columns 1-14, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: nagZ, ycfP, ndh, ycfJ, comR, bhsA, ldtC, mfd, ycfT, lolC, lolD, lolE, nagK, cobB
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 13-23%, all P; the branch's families: efeU, putP, "hypothetical protein", putA
